title: Equal Care Finland — 120-second pitch
vocabulary: Equal Care Finland, Helsinki, Satakunta, Gemini, Decisions API, Jev, Statistics Finland, roadmap.

lines.text: Finland invites every woman to free breast screening, and aims for eighty percent attendance.
lines.say: Finland invites every woman to free breast screening, and aims for eighty percent attendance.

lines.text: The county furthest behind is not rural. It is Helsinki.
lines.say: The county furthest behind is not rural. It is Helsinki.

lines.text: Equal Care Finland shows where cancer care falls behind, why, and what the national roadmap says to do.
lines.say: Equal Care Finland shows where cancer care falls behind, why, and what the national roadmap says to do.

lines.text: The core is a simulated population.
lines.say: The core is a simulated population.

lines.text: From Statistics Finland tables, we rebuild Helsinki's women as 771 resident types: age, language, education, work.
lines.say: From Statistics Finland tables, we rebuild Helsinki's women as seven hundred seventy-one resident types: age, language, education, work.

lines.text: Gemini's Decisions API judges each type once: will she attend, and what stops her?
lines.say: Gemini's Decisions API judges each type once: will she attend, and what stops her?

lines.text: It returns a probability and a barrier, and any dot opens the exact question behind it.
lines.say: It returns a probability and a barrier, and any dot opens the exact question behind it.

lines.text: Against real attendance in 22 counties, it correlates at 0.84.
lines.say: Against real attendance in twenty-two counties, it correlates at zero point eight four.

lines.text: It overstates the language gap, and the app shows that.
lines.say: It overstates the language gap, and the app shows that.

lines.text: A second engine, Jev, answers the same questions, so effects come as a range.
lines.say: A second engine, Jev, answers the same questions, so effects come as a range.

lines.text: Invitations in a person's own language bring 992 to 2,093 more women a year, across two models.
lines.say: Invitations in a person's own language bring nine hundred ninety-two to two thousand ninety-three more women a year, across two models.

lines.text: And it cites the roadmap: action 1.3.1, page 33.
lines.say: And it cites the roadmap: action one point three point one, page thirty-three.

lines.text: And beyond screening: the rest of the pathway.
lines.say: And beyond screening: the rest of the pathway.

lines.text: In Satakunta, 37.5 percent of oncology patients wait over ninety days, against 3.5 nationally.
lines.say: In Satakunta, thirty-seven point five percent of oncology patients wait over ninety days, against three point five nationally.

lines.text: That is eight patients, so the app warns about small numbers.
lines.say: That is eight patients, so the app warns about small numbers.

lines.text: Gemini writes the words. Code inserts and checks every number.
lines.say: Gemini writes the words. Code inserts and checks every number.

lines.text: Equal Care Finland. Where the gap is, why, and what to do next.
lines.say: Equal Care Finland. Where the gap is, why, and what to do next.
